assumptions.stated_applicability: roughly 50 big blind stacks and larger

schema.boundary_definition: Every hand that is orthogonally adjacent in the 13x13 chart to a hand with a different action; grouped by action pair.
schema.rfi_vs_3bet_prior_range_note: In RFI-vs-3bet charts, dark-gray Fold cells are hands in the prior RFI/limp range that fold to the new action. White Fold cells were outside the prior range. Both are preserved as action Fold; prior_range_hands and outside_prior_range_hands preserve the distinction.

SB RFI vs BB 3bet.source_note: AA, KK, and AKo are not in the SB RFI vs BB 3bet range because these hands were limped; the source says they are used as a limp/3-bet for value.

source_inconsistencies.handling: Preserved page 3 and page 10 independently; no silent correction was made.

method_notes: Each chart was read as a 13x13 hand matrix (169 hand classes). Cell background color was mapped to the action named in that chart legend.
Every chart was checked to contain 169 hand classes totaling 1326 weighted card combinations (pairs=6, suited=4, offsuit=12).
Page 3 RFI action totals were cross-checked against the printed combination totals and matched exactly.
For RFI-vs-3bet charts, dark-gray/colored prior-range cells were separated from white cells that were outside the preceding RFI/limp range.
